dataset.description: The dataset contains an experimental classifier developed to evaluate the suitability of territories for beekeeping by classifying OpenStreetMap (OSM) spatial data.

distribution.title: The classifier was developed and used as a supporting dataset to develop an experimental approach for real-time classification of OSM data in selected areas. The classifier is presented as a table that includes all known OSM features and their classification into specific categories of classes. It is important to note that the accuracy of the classifier has not been verified; therefore, the classification results should only be considered an experimental source of information.

dmp.description: This Data Management Plan is dedicated to enable management, storage and share the data across the research, related to implementation of the GIS solutions for the development of precision beekeeping.
